name: How long does a typical shower installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower installation varies depending on the project's scope. A straightforward replacement of an existing shower unit might take 2-4 days. However, a full bathroom remodel involving new plumbing, custom tiling, or structural changes could extend to 1-2 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project requirements, ensuring clear communication throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard shower replacement takes 2-4 days; full remodels can take 1-2 weeks, depending on project complexity.
